snippet.title: Rune Dice - Official Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase
snippet.description: Get another look at gameplay from Rune Dice in this trailer for the upcoming tactical deckbuilding game in bite-sized sessions. Launch dice to create magical chain reactions. Choose from distinct hero classes with unique abilities. Build synergies between dice, relics, and runes to defeat challenging bosses. Rune Dice will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
